description: This PHP class 'LocationSearchFilterParams' extends the 'FilterParams' class and encapsulates filtering parameters for location searches within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for location name, city, and country code, and maintains a list of allowed fields for sorting. It provides getter and setter methods for these properties and initializes default sorting behavior.

classes.name: LocationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used to filter and specify search criteria for location entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the default sort field to 'location.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current filter value for location name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the filter value for location name.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the current filter value for city.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the filter value for city.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the current filter value for country code.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the filter value for country code.
